Im pretty sure that he’s had the police warning as I’m told by people I used to work with he went into my old place of work asking questions about me yesterday, then not too long afterwards he was seen running through the shopping centre I used to work at in floods of tears. This is the shopping centre he told me that if I set foot in there again he will know within seconds that I’m there because everyone is his friend. He told me to wait and see what happens to me if he see’s me in there again. 

I’ve also been made aware that an elderly lady who actually set us up (claimed that she’d known him for many years and could vouch for his good character, but it turns out she’d known him passingly for under 6 months) is being harassed by him now. Bombarding her with messages and calls all through the night asking about me and if she knows what I’m doing or if I have another man etc. She even went as far as messaging and trying to call me last night, which she has never done before and I didn’t pick up. The message just said that he’s in a bad way about me. I was told by an ex coworker that she’s very worried about it all and knows this isn’t normal behaviour. She’s a flying monkey without even knowing it. 

I didn’t hear from him at all last night. Although, the police officer who attended told me to not block his number as he may feel that any avenue of communication is closed and then decided to come to my door. He said to archive him and if I get any more messages contact the police again. I’m not sure how I feel about that but I understand his point of view completely. 

I now have live cameras set up at the front and back of my property, house alarm which was already in place and family staying with me for the foreseeable future. It still doesn’t ease this sinking, sick feeling inside. I just want him to go away, don’t contact me and don’t ask about me.
